title: AI/ML Engineer
description:
**About NowOnline Tech India Pvt. Ltd.** 




  






 We are a dynamic and fast\-growing technology firm building production\-grade generative AI and agentic systems. Our team is passionate about shipping real products powered by large language models, multi\-agent workflows, and cutting\-edge AI research, while reasoning carefully about how these systems behave in the real world.
 




  






 Position Overview:
 




**Designation:** 

 AI/ML Engineer (Generative AI \& AI Agents)
 




**Type:** 

 Full\-time
 




**Experience Required:** 

 2\-3 years
 




**Location:** 

 GIFT City, Gandhinagar (On\-site)
 




**Compensation:** 

 Best in the industry.
 




  






 About the Role
 





 We are looking for an experienced AI/ML Engineer to take ownership of core generative AI and agentic systems initiatives. You will design, build, and ship production\-grade GenAI features and multi\-agent workflows, working closely with the AI/ML team and cross\-functional stakeholders on live products. This is a hands\-on role for someone who has already shipped GenAI features in production, can make independent architectural decisions, and enjoys mentoring junior engineers while reasoning carefully about how LLMs behave in the wild.
 




  






 Key Responsibilities
 



* Design, build, and own generative AI features end to end, including prompting, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), structured output generation, and evaluation
* Architect and lead development of AI agents and multi\-agent workflows that use tools, call APIs, and complete multi\-step tasks reliably at production scale
* Design and refine prompts, system instructions, and agent guardrails to improve accuracy, safety, and consistency, and set best practices for the team
* Own the vector database and embeddings strategy for semantic search and context retrieval across products
* Build and maintain evaluation harnesses to measure quality, latency, and cost, and drive systematic tuning and optimisation
* Integrate LLM capabilities into backend services and APIs, with attention to scalability, reliability, and cost efficiency
* Review the work of junior engineers and interns, and mentor them on GenAI and agentic system design
* Document findings, experiments, and design decisions clearly for the team and stakeholders
* Stay current with developments in generative AI, agentic frameworks, and industry best practices, and evaluate their fit for our stack
* Collaborate closely with product, engineering, and leadership to translate business requirements into technical solutions



  






 Required Skills \& Knowledge
 




***Core Engineering \& LLM Knowledge***



* Strong Python skills with a track record of writing clean, modular, production\-quality code
* Solid, applied understanding of core LLM concepts: tokens, context windows, prompting, embeddings, RAG, and fine\-tuning
* Strong understanding of REST APIs and experience integrating external services in production systems
* Proven ability to debug ambiguous LLM behaviour systematically and independently



***Generative AI \& Agents (Hands\-On)***



* 2\-3 years of hands\-on experience building and shipping generative AI features or products in a professional setting
* Practical experience with at least one agent or LLM framework (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, agent SDKs, or equivalent) in production
* Strong understanding of prompt engineering, system instructions, and agent guardrail design
* Demonstrated experience structuring and shipping reliable multi\-step, tool\-using workflows



***Technical Tools \& Technologies***



* Hands\-on experience with vector stores (e.g., Postgres/pgvector, Pinecone, Qdrant) and orchestration patterns
* Experience with Docker, job queues, or async task processing in production environments
* Solid backend service development and API integration experience
* Local LLM inference experience (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio) is a plus



***LLM Safety \& Reliability***



* Working knowledge of LLM safety topics such as prompt injection, jailbreak defenses, and output validation
* Experience with evaluation methods for measuring quality, latency, and cost, and using them to drive decisions



***Good to Have***



* Expertise in the Claude ecosystem: Claude API, Claude Code, the Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Skills, and prompt caching
* Experience building and operating multi\-agent or tool\-using systems in production settings
* Experience leading or mentoring junior engineers on GenAI projects
* Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects or technical blog posts demonstrating expertise


- 



 Soft Skills
 



* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities, with sound independent judgement
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to lead initiatives, mentor others, and work effectively across teams
* Attention to detail and ability to document findings clearly
* Curiosity, fast self\-learning, and a genuine passion for generative AI and emerging technologies



  






 Educational Qualifications
 



* BE/B.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field
* BCA or MCA graduates with strong, demonstrated experience in AI/ML and generative AI
* Equivalent practical experience and a strong portfolio will be considered in lieu of formal qualifications




 What We Offer
 



* Ownership of real features and initiatives within a modern GenAI and agentic stack used in production
* Opportunity to shape technical direction and mentor a growing AI/ML team
* Compensation that is best in the industry, based on experience and skill assessment
* Continuous learning and skill development in generative AI and agentic systems
* A clear path for career growth within the organisation
* Flexible work environment with on\-site collaboration



  






 What We Value in Candidates
 




  




* Genuine curiosity and passion for generative AI and agentic systems
* A track record of shipping and owning production GenAI features
* Strong work ethic and commitment to professional excellence
* Ability to work collaboratively and lead within a team environment
* Proactive approach to problem\-solving and finding innovative solutions
